sloka: हा कौसल्ये नशिष्यामि हा सुमित्रे तपस्विनि ।हा नृशम्से ममामित्रे कैकेयि कुलपाम्सनि ॥२-६४-७७॥
transliteration: hā kausalye naśiṣyāmi hā sumitre tapasvini ।hā nṛśamse mamāmitre kaikeyi kulapāmsani ॥2-64-77॥

translations.english: Ah, Kausalya, Ah, pitiable Sumitra, Ah, cruel Kaikeyi, my enemy and defiler of my race, I am going to die.
